name: Diddle-Dee Jam
desc: Jam from diddle-dee berries, the little red heath fruit that colours the Falkland hills. Tart and sweet, spread on a warm scone at smoko. Restores 120 HP.

name: Smoko Scone
desc: A warm scone with butter, the centrepiece of smoko, the mid-morning tea break that stops every Falkland farm and office at eleven. Restores 110 HP.

name: Smoko Hamper
desc: A wicker hamper of tea, scones and diddle-dee jam, packed by the Stanley baker for the peat cutters out in Camp. It is a very good hamper and a very long walk.

name: Gentoo Pebble
desc: A smooth pebble of the sort a gentoo penguin gives to its mate. A nest is a heap of stones, and a good pebble is a courtship gift. This one is a keepsake from the Falklands.
msg: {name}'s Gentoo Pebble gleamed in the cold!
